say:28:1820409023:1.text: Fine by me! You're the one who stole the limb; I've got nothing to fear!
say:28:1820409023:1.source_cn: 去就去，偷肢体的亡灵是你，我怕什么！
say:28:1820409023:1.male: Fine by me! You're the one who stole the limb; I've got nothing to fear!
say:28:1820409023:1.female: Fine by me! You're the one who stole the limb; I've got nothing to fear!

say:29:1820409024:1.female: I was going to see your boss anyway. The army's limbs went missing. The Repair House is responsible!

say:30:1820409025:1.female: Come on, follow me to the <style="highlight">Repair House</style>!

choice:27:0:1.female: What's the matter, scared to go?

choice:23:0:1.female: I'll say it one last time. I didn't steal anything.

choice:23:1:2.male: Let's head to the Repair House and let her decide.

choice:8:0:1.text: Why would I steal an arm?
choice:8:0:1.male: Why would I steal an arm?
choice:8:0:1.female: Why would I steal an arm?

choice:8:1:2.text: It's not like I need a third arm...
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 我又不需要第三条手臂……
choice:8:1:2.male: It's not like I need a third arm...
choice:8:1:2.female: It's not like I need a third arm...

choice:3:0:1.text: Are you sure you didn't miscount?
choice:3:0:1.male: Are you sure you didn't miscount?
choice:3:0:1.female: Are you sure you didn't miscount?

say:33:1820409004:1.text: You'd better not be joking about this!
say:33:1820409004:1.source_cn: 修缮屋的亡灵，你最好不要开这种玩笑！
say:33:1820409004:1.male: You'd better not be joking about this!
say:33:1820409004:1.female: You'd better not be joking about this!

choice:3:1:2.text: Did you hit your head too?
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 难道你刚刚还摔到了脑袋？
choice:3:1:2.male: Did you hit your head too?
choice:3:1:2.female: Did you hit your head too?

say:0:1820410001:0.text: You'll pay thirty thousand... no, at least a hundred thousand iron to make up for the army's loss!
say:0:1820410001:0.source_cn: 我要让你们赔偿三万……不，至少十万黑铁币，才能弥补军队...
say:0:1820410001:0.male: You'll pay thirty thousand... no, at least a hundred thousand iron to make up for the army's loss!
say:0:1820410001:0.female: You'll pay thirty thousand... no, at least a hundred thousand iron to make up for the army's loss!

say:1:1820411001:1.text: You brought the supplies back, right? What took you so long?
say:1:1820411001:1.source_cn: 货带回来了吧。怎么耽搁了这么久？

say:2:1820411002:1.text: You should ask this new employee of yours!
say:2:1820411002:1.source_cn: 那就要问问你们修缮屋新招的这名员工了！
say:2:1820411002:1.male: You should ask this new employee of yours!
say:2:1820411002:1.female: You should ask this new employee of yours!

say:4:1820411004:1.text: What's going on? Hmph! I was under army orders to deliver this shipment of replacement limbs.
say:4:1820411004:1.source_cn: 怎么回事？哼！我奉军队命令，来运送这批重要的肢体资源。

say:5:1820411005:1.text: On the way, I was unfortunately attacked by a beast outside the city and knocked unconscious. Luckily, my hound fought it off and saved the shipment.
say:5:1820411005:1.source_cn: 路上，我不幸在城外遭遇了野兽的袭击，昏迷不醒。还好我的...

say:6:1820411006:1.text: And then your new employee here, without even asking what happened, started beating my hound! That's assault on a military dog!
say:6:1820411006:1.source_cn: 结果——你们的这个新员工，竟然不管事情经由，上去就对我...
say:6:1820411006:1.male: And then your new employee here, without even asking what happened, started beating my hound! That's assault on a military dog!
say:6:1820411006:1.female: And then your new employee here, without even asking what happened, started beating my hound! That's assault on a military dog!

say:7:1820411007:1.text: That alone would be bad enough. But he also stole <style="highlight">a critical replacement limb</style>!
say:7:1820411007:1.male: That alone would be bad enough. But he also stole <style="highlight">a critical replacement limb</style>!
say:7:1820411007:1.female: That alone would be bad enough. But she also stole <style="highlight">a critical replacement limb</style>!

say:8:1820411008:1.text: That was a premium arm, specially commissioned by the army for one of our brave soldiers!
say:8:1820411008:1.source_cn: 那可是一条上好的手臂，是军队点名要为一位英勇的士兵更换...

say:9:1820411009:1.text: Not only did he steal military property, he even refused to admit it or pay for the loss!
say:9:1820411009:1.male: Not only did he steal military property, he even refused to admit it or pay for the loss!
say:9:1820411009:1.female: Not only did she steal military property, she even refused to admit it or pay for the loss!

say:10:1820411010:1.text: What kind of employee did you hire? You need to severely punish him!
say:10:1820411010:1.source_cn: 老板，你们这都招的什么新员工啊？严惩，必须严惩！
say:10:1820411010:1.male: What kind of employee did you hire? You need to severely punish him!
say:10:1820411010:1.female: What kind of employee did you hire? You need to severely punish her!

say:11:1820411011:0.text: Who do you think you are, coming to the Repair House and making a scene?
say:11:1820411011:0.source_cn: 你是个什么东西，敢来修缮屋胡搅蛮缠？

say:13:1820411013:0.text: This old woman doesn't have time to teach you how to listen. If you can't hear clearly, go beg your army to send you a new pair!
say:13:1820411013:0.source_cn: 老身没那么多闲工夫陪你练耳力。听不清话，就滚去求你们军...

say:14:1820411014:0.text: I'll say it one last time. Your new employee stole military property!
say:14:1820411014:0.source_cn: ——我再说一次，你的新员工偷走了军队重要的肢体资源！
say:14:1820411014:0.male: I'll say it one last time. Your new employee stole military property!
say:14:1820411014:0.female: I'll say it one last time. Your new employee stole military property!

say:15:1820411015:0.text: Pah! You dare say that again? How shameless can you be!
say:15:1820411015:0.source_cn: 呸，你还敢说！真是给脸不要脸！

say:16:1820411016:0.text: This old woman has lived many years, but I'm not so senile that a fool like you can fool me!
say:16:1820411016:0.source_cn: 老身是多活了些岁数，但还没老糊涂到可以让你这废物随便诓骗！

say:17:1820411017:0.text: This newcomer has only been dead a few days. He barely knows left from right.
say:17:1820411017:0.source_cn: 这个新来的才刚死几天，连往生眩晕症都不知道，常识缺乏得厉害。
say:17:1820411017:0.male: This newcomer has only been dead a few days. He barely knows left from right.
say:17:1820411017:0.female: This newcomer has only been dead a few days. She barely knows left from right.

say:18:1820411018:0.text: Steal a limb? I'd sooner believe he got spooked by it and dropped the shipment!
say:18:1820411018:0.male: Steal a limb? I'd sooner believe he got spooked by it and dropped the shipment!
say:18:1820411018:0.female: Steal a limb? I'd sooner believe she got spooked by it and dropped the shipment!

choice_prompt:19:1820411018.text: Steal a limb? I'd sooner believe he got spooked by it and dropped the shipment!
choice_prompt:19:1820411018.source_cn: 偷肢体？你不如说<male>他</male><female>她</female>被那条手臂吓了一跳，把货物扔在地上，还勉强算有点可信度！
choice_prompt:19:1820411018.male: Steal a limb? I'd sooner believe he got spooked by it and dropped the shipment!
choice_prompt:19:1820411018.female: Steal a limb? I'd sooner believe she got spooked by it and dropped the shipment!

say:20:1820411019:1.text: How can you side with him?! This is damaging the interests of the Bantus army!
say:20:1820411019:1.male: How can you side with him?! This is damaging the interests of the Bantus army!
say:20:1820411019:1.female: How can you side with her?! This is damaging the interests of the Bantus army!

say:21:1820411020:0.text: Bantus? Hmph! This old woman lives in Novaris. I don't pledge loyalty to Bantus.
say:21:1820411020:0.source_cn: 班题斯？哼！老身生活在诺珐斯，效忠的不是班题斯。

say:22:1820411021:0.text: Don't try to bully this old woman with your army talk. It makes me sick!
say:22:1820411021:0.source_cn: 少拿你们的军队精神来压我这个老婆子，听着让老身恶心！

say:23:1820411022:0.text: If the Lady hadn't said you agreed to provide Novaris with a stable limb supply, the Repair House would never have cooperated with the army at all.
say:23:1820411022:0.source_cn: 要不是领主阁下授意，说你们同意给诺珐斯提供稳定的肢体，...

say:24:1820411023:1.text: Save your strength. I wouldn't want your tongue to fall off from overwork.
say:24:1820411023:1.source_cn: 歇歇力气吧，免得把自己的舌头累得掉下来。

say:25:1820411024:1.text: Our agreement covers limb maintenance, not fixing that mouth of yours.
say:25:1820411024:1.source_cn: 协议中，老身帮忙维护肢体的范畴可不包括你嘴里的玩意。

say:27:1820411026:1.text: I'll report this to the army! You'll pay for this! Both of you will end up on the execution block—none of you will escape!
say:27:1820411026:1.source_cn: 我要上报军队！我要你们都遭受最严重的责罚！你们两个都会...
say:27:1820411026:1.male: I'll report this to the army! You'll pay for this! Both of you will end up on the execution block—none of you will escape!
say:27:1820411026:1.female: I'll report this to the army! You'll pay for this! Both of you will end up on the execution block—none of you will escape!

say:28:1820411027:1.source_cn: 那就去说吧！老身倒想看看，你被丢进刑场时，嘴巴是不是也...

say:30:1820411029:1.text: You have a military hound with you. If you'd truly encountered a beast vicious enough to knock you out, it would have been torn to shreds.
say:30:1820411029:1.source_cn: 你身边可是带着军队的猎犬。要是真遇到能将你击晕的凶恶野...

say:31:1820411030:1.text: Yet it's completely unharmed. So which is it? Are you really so weak that a beast your own hound could chase off still managed to knock you unconscious?
say:31:1820411030:1.source_cn: 可它却完好无损。是你太过孱弱，被一只连猎犬都能驱逐的野...

say:32:1820411031:0.text: Or did your cowardly hound abandon you and only slink back after the beast had gone?
say:32:1820411031:0.source_cn: 还是说，你的猎犬胆小怕事抛下逃走，直到野兽离开才敢回来？

say:35:1820411033:1.text: Look at that. Even your own hound thinks your lies are pathetic.
say:35:1820411033:1.source_cn: 瞧瞧，连这只猎犬都对你那拙劣的谎话不屑一顾。

say:36:1820411034:1.text: As far as this old woman can tell, that "beast" of yours never existed.
say:36:1820411034:1.source_cn: 依老身看，你口中的那只野兽，压根就不存在吧？

say:37:1820411035:1.text: Y-you're lying! This is slander against the army's reputation!
say:37:1820411035:1.source_cn: 你——你胡说！这是对军队声誉严重的毁谤！

say:38:1820411036:1.text: You two! Mark my words—this isn't over!
say:38:1820411036:1.source_cn: 你，还有你！你们两个给我记住了，这事没完！
say:38:1820411036:1.male: You two! Mark my words—this isn't over!
say:38:1820411036:1.female: You two! Mark my words—this isn't over!

narration:39:1820411037:1.text: After hurling a few last, thoroughly unconvincing threats, the guard slinks off with his hound in tow.

narration:40:1820411038:1.text: You look at Baba Muriel, still simmering with anger. The relationship between the Repair House and the Bantus army seems a bit different from what you imagined...
narration:40:1820411038:1.male: You look at Baba Muriel, still simmering with anger. The relationship between the Repair House and the Bantus army seems a bit different from what you imagined...
narration:40:1820411038:1.female: You look at Baba Muriel, still simmering with anger. The relationship between the Repair House and the Bantus army seems a bit different from what you imagined...

narration:41:1820411039:1.text: This might be the perfect chance to question Baba Muriel.
narration:41:1820411039:1.male: This might be the perfect chance to question Baba Muriel.
narration:41:1820411039:1.female: This might be the perfect chance to question Baba Muriel.

choice:19:0:1.text: I really didn't steal any limbs.
choice:19:0:1.male: I really didn't steal any limbs.
choice:19:0:1.female: I really didn't steal any limbs.

choice:19:1:2.text: Just to be clear, I wouldn't get startled by an arm.
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 强调一下，我不会被手臂吓一跳
choice:19:1:2.male: Just to be clear, I wouldn't get startled by an arm.
choice:19:1:2.female: Just to be clear, I wouldn't get startled by an arm.

say:1:1820412001:1.text: What's the matter, scared by those Bantus army madmen?
say:1:1820412001:1.source_cn: 怎么？被班题斯军队的疯子吓到了？
say:1:1820412001:1.male: What's the matter, scared by those Bantus army madmen?
say:1:1820412001:1.female: What's the matter, scared by those Bantus army madmen?

say:2:1820412002:0.text: They're just a bunch of fools. Your courage is a bit lacking.
say:2:1820412002:0.male: They're just a bunch of fools. Your courage is a bit lacking.
say:2:1820412002:0.female: They're just a bunch of fools. Your courage is a bit lacking.

choice_prompt:3:1820412002.source_cn: 一群废物而已。<male>小伙子</male><female>小丫头</female>，你胆子未免也太小了些。
choice_prompt:3:1820412002.male: They're just a bunch of fools. Your courage is a bit lacking.
choice_prompt:3:1820412002.female: They're just a bunch of fools. Your courage is a bit lacking.

say:4:1820412003:1.text: Don't look so moved, like you're about to die a second time.
say:4:1820412003:1.source_cn: 别一副感动到要二次死亡的表情。
say:4:1820412003:1.male: Don't look so moved, like you're about to die a second time.
say:4:1820412003:1.female: Don't look so moved, like you're about to die a second time.

say:5:1820412005:1.text: Afterlife vertigo can relapse. Being overly tense and anxious won't help your recovery.
say:5:1820412005:1.source_cn: 往生晕眩症有复发的可能，过度紧张焦虑对你的后遗症恢复没好处。

say:5:1820412005:1.female: Afterlife vertigo can relapse. Being overly tense and anxious won't help your recovery.
